periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 50-degree downward angle relative to the horizontal facial plane towards the rostrum
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval with a ratio of approximately 2:1
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering forming a teardrop shape below the ocular center

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape at the posterior boundary across the scapular region
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick, spanning approximately one-third of the visible upper torso height

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, approximately 1.5 times the width of the individual pinna base
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly rounded and convex apical edges

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint pinkish/reddish discoloration patch visible on the sagittal crown area of the head
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow staining or pigmentation on the ventral fur surface and inner thighs
